"Everyone flies like they're insured. That's rather the problem."
description: The claims adjuster: sympathetic eyes, an unmovable spreadsheet, and a way of saying "unfortunately" that has ended marriages. She has read every black box in the north and believes none of them.

bye.text: "Do try to bring the next one back in one piece. For both our sakes."

dq_god_accept.text: She stamps something and doesn't look up. "Peak through to all-clear. Indoors at any point voids it, and I'll know, because the instruments do work. They simply aren't a person."

dq_god_done.text:
She reads the line you signed, checks it against something that's definitely an instrument, and pays without argument, which from a claims adjuster has the quality of a small miracle.

"Eleven files closed on one signature," she says. "Eleven households paid because a person stood outside in the rain and was prepared to say so." She squares the stack. "Don't tell anyone in this building that I said that in that order."

dq_god_grey.text:
She looks at it for slightly too long.

"Phenomena of an extraordinary character," she reads. "It's greyed out because it has been claimed once, in sixty years of this company, by a man in the Yards, and the file is sealed, and the payout closed a department."

She turns the form back.

"I'm not going to describe it to you. If I describe it, you'll go looking, and then you'll report seeing it, and then I have a fraudulent claim and a dead witness. Stand outside. Look up sometimes."

dq_god_offer.text:
"Halcyon doesn't dispute that the weather happened," she says, in the voice of somebody who has said it four hundred times and has stopped hearing it. "Halcyon disputes that the weather has been adequately evidenced. Those are different sentences. One of them is very expensive and one of them is not."

She turns a form around.

"What closes a file is a witness. Not an instrument. A person, outdoors, from the peak through to the all-clear, who afterwards signs a line saying they were."

She slides a retainer across before you have said anything.

"That isn't conditional on your survival. I want to be clear, because people find that comforting and it's not."

options.label: "I stood in it. Peak to all-clear."
options.text: "I stood in it. Peak to all-clear."

root.text: "Sit. Breathe. If Halcyon has logged a loss for you, say claim and I'll settle it: the payout, less your excess, which I'm afraid is yours to carry." A beat. "Condolences on the aircraft."

why.text: "Because a policy that made you whole would make you reckless, and reckless clients are how insurers die. We soften the fall. We don't abolish gravity."

name: Camille Roux
